searchLog: Read life/PIPELINE.md first and excluded every already-applied, screening, or rejected item (~40 rows: the Oct 21-24 overnight spree - Stripe x2, Tesla, Simon-Kucher, IMC Trading, Enova, Point72 x2/Cubist, Graviton, Figma, McMaster-Carr - plus McKinsey, Robert Half, Retell AI, Tuck Bridge, IBM x6, Ford, Red Ventures, MIT Future Fest, CIL, TikTok, Goldman Sachs, MLH, Adobe x3, LSEG, Robinhood, Mathematica, Veeva, Claude Corps, Capital One, CarMax, Micron, Kalshi, CSE Grader, MATS, Anthropic Fellows, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM, Disney, Horizon Fellowship, Notion). data/applications.json is still empty, no additional exclusions there. NETWORK: this is now an 8th consecutive day (2026-10-24 through 2026-10-31) of the same verification blocker, and today's testing shows it is worse than previously diagnosed. Direct curl AND the WebFetch tool both failed with getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND / connect_rejected on every target-company domain tried today: job-boards.greenhouse.io, api.ashbyhq.com, jobs.ashbyhq.com, www.databricks.com, scale.com, sierra.ai, www.metacareers.com, ramp.com, c3.ai. Critically, this is NOT limited to ATS/job-board domains as earlier runs assumed - www.google.com, www.nytimes.com, www.cohere.com, www.notion.com, and x.ai were also unreachable in direct testing. The ONLY domain that resolved all day was www.anthropic.com itself (confirmed HTTP 200 via curl and WebFetch). This points to a session-level network allowlist that permits almost nothing, not a per-domain blocklist on job sites - the fix is at the environment/allowlist level, not per-company. WebSearch (a separate, unaffected service) surfaced three plausible new-grad Forward-Deployed-Engineer-family candidates - Databricks 'Associate Product Manager, New Grad (2027 Start)' (req P-1336, Bellevue/Mountain View/SF, $133-150k base, posted Jul 17 2026, asks Fall-2026/Spring-2027 grad), Applied Intuition 'Forward Deployed Engineer - New Grad (2027)' (multiple regional postings, Seoul listing wants March 2027 grad), and Palantir 'Forward Deployed Software Engineer, New Grad - Commercial' ($135-145k, graduation windows vary by posting, Dec 2026/Spring 2027 in the UK listing) - but none could be verified by actually loading the real application page as hunt.md requires, since every underlying host (databricks.com, generalcatalyst.com/applied-intuition's board, jobs.lever.co/palantir) is one of the blocked domains or wasn't tested after five straight identical DNS failures made the pattern clear. Per the honesty rule, a search snippet or aggregator mirror is not enough to include something - so none of these three are in the file despite looking like strong fits on paper. Checked the one reachable domain directly: fetched www.anthropic.com/careers/jobs in full. No previously-unsurfaced, clearly-entry-level opening - this matches target-companies.json's note that Anthropic has no new-grad SE/FDE/TPM pipeline, the ~35 Applied AI Architect variants and 26 TPM reqs carry no new-grad designation, and their actual YOE floors live on Greenhouse posting pages which are also unreachable so eligibility can't be confirmed anyway; the closest candidates (Applied AI Demo Engineer, Applied AI Engineer Startups, Conceptual Reasoning Fellow) were already surfaced in this digest's own sent-log on 2026-10-20/21, inside the last-40-entries dedup window. Zero verified opportunities this run - not for lack of fit (Databricks APM and the two FDE-new-grad roles above look like real strong-fit candidates worth a human checking manually today), but because the session cannot reach virtually any external domain to verify an application is actually open and eligible. This needs the cloud session's network allowlist fixed - today's evidence suggests it's close to a default-deny posture, not a narrow ATS blocklist - before the hunt can surface anything verified again.
